svg.title: MediaLog
svg.desc: MediaLog, as a 1993 VGA voxel flight at dusk. Under a navy sky with a few stars, the MediaLog mark (an open book with a play triangle and a pen) and the name in heavy condensed white letters with a hard dark shadow. Under them, the line: Everything you've watched, read, played, listened to, on one timeline. Below, the camera flies low over rolling hills planted in stripes, one stripe per kind of media in its own colour: movies red, TV and anime blue, videos plum, books amber, comics and manga magenta, games green, podcasts violet, music teal. The nearest hills are drawn in fine pixels with blossoms streaming past, the middle distance in blocks twice the size, the far hills in blocks four times the size, and past that only a pink fog. A timeline ruler on the right labels the bands 2025-2029, 2020-2024 and SOMETIME IN 2015-2019, its line dotted on into the fog. Every hill after the first two, one verb in the line lights up in turn and the landscape recolours to match: only the kinds that verb covers stay in colour, the rest go grey, and the play triangle in the mark takes the verb's colour.
